assemblies.label: The ground
assemblies.note: The surfaces it is painted with, each in patches of its own size.

assemblies.label: The cover
assemblies.note: What grows and lies on it, kind by kind, each in its colonies.

assemblies.label: Where it gathers
assemblies.note: Its cover placed by masks: under crowns or in the sun, at the canopy’s edge, off the paths, in the hollows, round the trunks.

parts.label: Leaf litter
parts.what: A surface of the ground, painted in patches that run into the others; its weight is how much of the floor it takes against them.
